speaker: Shmuley Boteach
review: The full response and single-speaker segment sequence corroborate Boteach's persecution-and-resistance argument, his account of the temple desecration, and his Saddam Hussein comparison. Hanukkah and the Maccabees replace garbled caption spellings without changing the claim. The historian's surname differs between captions and audio transcription (Goodman/Goodwin); do not quote that name or treat the spelling discrepancy as his factual error. The clipped transition around slaughter his people does not affect the clear resistance analogy. The chosen quotation standing up against their own brutal oppressors is corroborated; the cruel-way quotation is likewise audible. Historical reports remain speaker assertions, not independently verified facts.
